title: 23 December 1964: Rehearsal: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the third consecutive day of rehearsals for Another Beatles Christmas Show, which opened the following day at London’s Hammersmith Odeon.

Page last updated: 24 April 2010

Also on this day...

  • 1999: An intruder breaks into George Harrison’s Hawaiian home
  • 1972: World première of Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1969: Travel: John Lennon – Toronto to London
  • 1969: John Lennon and Yoko Ono meet Canadian prime minister Pierre Trudeau
  • 1968: The 1968 Apple Christmas party
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
